== DS-61-2 (October 2026) ==
Line 48 of the scanned sheet reads "DS-61-2" followed by a crossed-out "(V)". No DS-61-2 (V) card exists in the PC card data ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] and Dark.json at commit d4e661ec) or on the wiki, so the link now points at the Premiere card [[DS-61-2]]. == Admiral Ozzel (October 2026) ==
Line 46 of the scanned sheet reads "ADMIRAL OZZEL" followed by a crossed-out "(V)", the same mark as on line 48 (DS-61-2) and line 4 (Prepared Defenses). Line 47 is a second Admiral Ozzel with no mark. Line 45 has a "(V)" that is not crossed out, for comparison. The list now shows 2x [[Admiral Ozzel]].
* The original-era Admiral Ozzel (V) is in the PC card data as a legacy card, set 1002 (Virtual Block 2), with no release date or legality field ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] at commit d4e661ec. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020201857/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec/DarkLegacy.json.html Internet Archive]). The other Admiral Ozzel (V) in Dark.json is set 213, Virtual Set 13, from 2020.
* The original slip is in [[Admiral Ozzel (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)|Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational]], with official text as of 22 December 2007 ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards14.pdf VirtualCards14.pdf]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193310/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards14.pdf Internet Archive]). This is after the 5–7 October 2007 event, whose pool was [[Premiere - Original VS13]]. So no Admiral Ozzel (V) was legal at 2007 Worlds.
